facts.text: The user asked whether someone exists who can tell aliens vs humans.
The user said the user, Max, and the user are a good start for a team.
The user asked whether John Lynch and Max Cash have code names.
The user thought Max Cash was Red Alert.
The user apologized and said it is really Condition Red.
The user said the team starts with Topkick, Condition Red, and the user.
The user asked what to call aliens who can shapeshift into people.
The user said there is a name for these aliens in the Wildstorm universe.
The user said to go with that name.
The user instructed Condition Red to do research on daemonites.
The user said that if anyone else is talking about daemonites, they can attempt to contact them.
